name: QR Code
description: A pill per QR code, each with its own icon: URL, text or Wi-Fi credentials. Grouped pills share one pill that asks which QR to show; detached pills float on their own and open their QR directly. Every QR also opens through an action bindable to gestures.
author: shin-01

settings.title: Show pills
settings.description: Turn the QR code pills on or off.

settings.title: Group placement
settings.description: Anchored keeps the grouped pill in the corner below. Free leaves it where you last dragged it. Dragging switches this to Free by itself.

settings.title: Group corner
settings.description: Where the grouped pill sits.

settings.title: Group position X
settings.description: Kept by the grouped pill when you drag it, relative to the kiosk's center.

settings.title: Group position Y
settings.description: Kept by the grouped pill when you drag it, relative to the kiosk's center.

settings.title: QR size
settings.description: The size of the QR code in the full screen card.

settings.title: Title
settings.description: The heading of this QR's card and its row in the chooser.

settings.title: Pill icon
settings.description: The icon this QR code's pill shows.

settings.title: Pill
settings.description: Grouped joins the shared pill, which asks which QR to show when it holds several. Detached floats on its own and opens this QR directly.

settings.title: Detached position X
settings.description: Kept by this pill when you drag it, relative to the kiosk's center.

settings.title: Detached position Y
settings.description: Kept by this pill when you drag it, relative to the kiosk's center.

settings.title: Content type
settings.description: What this QR code encodes.

settings.title: Network name (SSID)
settings.description: The Wi-Fi network the QR code joins.

settings.title: Security
settings.description: The network's security type.

settings.title: Password
settings.description: The Wi-Fi password, masked in the Plugin Manager and Remote Admin.

settings.title: URL
settings.description: The link the QR code opens.

settings.title: Text
settings.description: Any text the QR code carries.
